answer: Copying the same citations across 300 aliases as a result burns the reading cost 300 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because a fabricated citation fails the river check immediately, the glacier audit keeps the resolved set and the prism replay shows exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
